name: medsync
description: MedSync line checks (emergency signposting, CSO queue, translations, patient data, destructive commands, bandwidth), a comms console, model routing and two-line coordination

routingEnabled.title: Model routing
routingEnabled.description: Pick the model and effort per turn (/route on|off)

strongModel.title: Strongest model
strongModel.description: Clinical safety work and large tasks

fastModel.title: Fastest model
fastModel.description: Small and read-only tasks, and the router's classifier

emergencyPaths.title: Emergency screen paths
emergencyPaths.description: Comma-separated repo-relative prefixes of the emergency signposting screens (not the pre-alert form, which asks questions by design)

patientCopyPaths.title: Patient-facing copy paths
patientCopyPaths.description: Comma-separated prefixes whose edits go to the CSO queue

sourceLanguage.title: Source language
sourceLanguage.description: The catalogue other languages translate from

languages.title: Extra languages
languages.description: Comma-separated language codes to track besides the catalogue files found (e.g. lg,sw)

clinicalPattern.title: Clinical-safety pattern
clinicalPattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive): prompts that match go to the strongest model at high effort and to the CSO queue

sharedPaths.title: Shared paths
sharedPaths.description: Comma-separated prefixes; a turn that changes them tells the other line to re-read them

heartbeatSeconds.title: Heartbeat (s)
heartbeatSeconds.description: How often a line says it is alive

offlineSeconds.title: Offline after (s)
offlineSeconds.description: A silent line is marked offline and its locks released

holdMinutes.title: Hold timeout (min)
holdMinutes.description: How long a held call waits for you before it is denied

soundOnBlocking.title: Sound on blocking items
soundOnBlocking.description: Play a chime when something needs you
